CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_auth_user_settings()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, username, display_name, role, avatar_url)
  values (
    new.id,
    case
      when coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'username', new.raw_user_meta_data->>'user_name')
        ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,32}$'
      then lower(coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'username', new.raw_user_meta_data->>'user_name'))
      else null
    end,
    nullif(coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', new.raw_user_meta_data->>'name'), ''),
    'student',
    nullif(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'avatar_url', '')
  )
  on conflict (id) do nothing;

  insert into public.user_preferences (user_id)
  values (new.id)
  on conflict (user_id) do nothing;

  return new;
exception
  when unique_violation then
    insert into public.profiles (id, display_name, role, avatar_url)
    values (
      new.id,
      nullif(coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', new.raw_user_meta_data->>'name'), ''),
      'student',
      nullif(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'avatar_url', '')
    )
    on conflict (id) do nothing;

    insert into public.user_preferences (user_id)
    values (new.id)
    on conflict (user_id) do nothing;
    return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_email_otp_session_verified()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.email_otp_verified_sessions s
  where s.user_id=(select auth.uid())
   and s.session_id=nullif((select auth.jwt()->>'session_id'),'')::uuid
   and s.expires_at>now());
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_auth_user_consent()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if nullif(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'terms_accepted_at','') is not null
     and new.raw_user_meta_data->>'terms_accepted_at' is distinct from old.raw_user_meta_data->>'terms_accepted_at' then
    update public.profiles
    set terms_accepted_at=now(), consented_at=now(),
        terms_version='v1', privacy_version='v1', updated_at=now()
    where id=new.id;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: sync_profile_password_configured
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_profile_password_configured()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if coalesce(new.encrypted_password, '') <> '' then
    update public.profiles
    set password_configured_at = coalesce(password_configured_at, now())
    where id = new.id;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
